description: This file contains several CMake functions, macros, and scripts for managing build dependencies, target properties, and package/configuration file generation within a CMake-based build system. It includes utilities for handling target link libraries, include directories, compile options, and generator expressions, as well as functions for installing CMake package configurations, find modules, and related support files.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a specified list variable.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves and accumulates link libraries and directories for a given target, handling imported and local targets, and resolving interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Collects and outputs compile definitions from a target and its interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Gathers compile options from a target and its interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Obtains include directories from a target and its interface dependencies, resolving relative paths.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs CMake configuration files for a target, supporting versioning, dependencies, and templates.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a target, including compile options, defines, include paths, and libraries.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs find modules (.cmake files) from a specified directory, optionally recursing.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Displays all supported CMake property names.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Prints all properties supported by a specific target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Replaces semicolons in a string with an ASCII character to make it safe for passing through CMake variables.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a legacy interface library for backward compatibility, linking to a specified target, and installing headers and configs.
